description.value: Billed as Vancouver's first cider taphouse, The Cider House pours over 20 BC-crafted ciders on tap in the heart of Kitsilano, steps from Kitsilano Beach. The kitchen is fully plant-based, with locally sourced ingredients and a menu spanning shareable bites, burgers, tacos, and bowls — all vegan, many gluten-free. Its community-driven ethos and beach-adjacent location make it a distinctive stop for cyclists exploring the Kitsilano corridor.
